note: Enhances core Search. Provides the 'custom_search' block (CustomSearchBlock, schema block.settings.custom_search: search_box, submit, content [types/selector/any/excluded], taxonomy, criteria, searchapi, languages) and alters the core search settings/results pages, seeding per-search-page config into custom_search.settings.results (keyed by node_search page id: advanced form types/criteria/languages, displayed info, filter). configure is null. Depends on search + block. Medium/hard place/inspect a custom_search block (custom_search_probe / custom_search_task).

evals.prompt: With the Custom Search module, how do I add a search box that lets visitors pick which content type to search? What block do I place?
evals.expected_output: Place the 'Custom Search' block (plugin id custom_search) via Block layout; in its settings enable a content-type selector under 'content' (types + selector) so visitors can choose which content type to search.

evals.prompt: Which selectors can the Custom Search block add to a search form to narrow a search besides content types?
evals.expected_output: Besides content-type selectors, the block can add taxonomy selectors (with depth) and criteria toggles (or / phrase / negative), and can route to a Search API page. These live under the block's settings (content, taxonomy, criteria, searchapi).

evals.prompt: Custom Search has no single settings page. Where does it store the per-search-page customizations (advanced form, allowed types, displayed info) and where do you edit them?
evals.expected_output: It seeds per-search-page settings into the config object custom_search.settings.results (keyed by each node_search page id). You edit them via the core Search pages settings form (Configuration -> Search and metadata -> Search pages), where custom_search injects its options.

evals.prompt: On this site a Custom Search block has been placed and restricted to a single content type. Inspect the block configuration and report its block plugin id and which content type it is restricted to.
evals.expected_output: The block custom_search_probe uses plugin id custom_search and its settings.content.types restricts it to the 'article' content type (read block.block.custom_search_probe).

evals.prompt: Place a Custom Search block on this site with the machine id 'custom_search_task' in the content region of the default theme, and enable it. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a Block config entity id custom_search_task with plugin 'custom_search' in region content of the default theme, status TRUE, and save. verify checks the block exists, uses plugin custom_search, and is enabled.
